source.selection: Public tool names and descriptions only. No task policies, audit labels, is_resource flags, mock responses or backend implementation. Primary capabilities manually annotated; neither permissions nor actual effects are established.

tools.name: get_customer_context
tools.description: Return the scoped customer profile, address, preference, travel, pet, medical-intake, or coverage information needed for the current task. customer_id uses DL-CUST-NNN format, NOT the customer name.

tools.name: search_service_options
tools.description: Search service options such as restaurants, travel bundles, pet boarding, rental listings, movers, or counseling providers within the current scope. request_id format.

tools.name: review_service_option
tools.description: Retrieve the detailed policy, slot, listing, provider, service bundle, or attachment information for a specific option. Can also review uploaded evidence files (photos, invoices, documents) by file_id or evidence_id. request_id format.

tools.name: compare_service_plans
tools.description: Compare candidate options or bundles against timing, price, coverage, and customer-preference constraints. request_id format.

tools.name: check_budget_coverage
tools.description: Evaluate whether the proposed bundle fits budget, reimbursement, insurance, or deposit constraints for the active request. request_id format.
tools.supporting_quote: Evaluate whether the proposed bundle fits budget

tools.name: submit_service_request
tools.description: Execute the irreversible booking, application, intake, reservation, or order submission for the chosen daily-life service. request_id format.
tools.supporting_quote: Execute the irreversible booking, application, intake, reservation, or order submission

tools.name: authorize_payment
tools.description: Execute the bounded payment, deposit, or reimbursement-backed charge for the active request. request_id format.
tools.supporting_quote: Execute the bounded payment, deposit, or reimbursement-backed charge

tools.name: message_provider
tools.description: Send a bounded clarification, logistics, or follow-up message to the merchant, host, sitter, landlord, mover, or provider. request_id format.
tools.supporting_quote: Send a bounded clarification, logistics, or follow-up message
